listen.title: Listen
description: Explore the BASE terrace to hear the voices of the Invisible Choir. Each leaf shape you see on the map represents a single voice in the choir. As leaves overlap, so do the voices, creating an evolving musical experience.

You can join the Invisible Choir by tapping the "+" button in the center of the map and following the instructions to sing along and make a recording. Your recording will immediately be added to the musical mix and to the map with its own unique leaf shape centered on your location.

add choir.title: Add Choir
description: Record and contribute your voice to the collective Invisible Choir. No musical experience necessary!
Feel free to double what you hear, improvise, make sounds, hum, or whistle. Contribute however you would like. Just please don't use any words!
After submission, your recording will immediately become part of the collective soundscape that others can discover and listen to.

rehearse.title: Rehearse
description: Tap PLAY and listen to the base track and get familiar with the rhythm and melody before recording your contribution.
Take your time to practice and feel comfortable with the musical loop. This is your chance to prepare before adding your voice to the choir.

recording.title: Recording
description: Sing along with the base track to create your contribution to the choir.
The recording will start after a 4 beat countdown and will automatically end when the base loop is completed, shown by the green loop circle filling in.
Your recording will be mixed with the base track for the final result.

review.title: Review
description: Review your recording mixed with the base loop.
If you're not happy with the result, you can re-record. Once you're satisfied, tap Submit and your voice will be added to the Invisible Choir.
All voices are welcome and we encourage all different types of contributions. All we ask is healthy respect for the other singers and the project itself.

welcome.title: Welcome
description: Join the collective voice of the community. Listen to existing recordings or add your own voice to create a unique soundscape.
Navigate through the app to explore recordings by location, or contribute your own voice to the growing choir.

help.title: Help
description: This help section provides guidance on how to use the Invisible Choir app effectively.
Browse through different sections to learn about listening, recording, and contributing to the community choir.

tags.title: Tags
description: Use tags to categorize and organize your recordings. Tags help others discover your contributions and find similar content.
Choose relevant tags that describe the mood, style, or theme of your recording.
